test_objective: Check that the JSON-LD @context is obtained from a Link header if present and that the default JSON-LD @context is used if not present

test_cases.name: 036_05_01 EmptyJsonLdContext
test_cases.doc: Check that the JSON-LD @context is obtained from a Link header if present and that the default JSON-LD @context is used if not present
test_cases.template: Review JSON-LD resolution when retrieving a context source registration
test_cases.then:
then {
    the SUT sends a valid Response for the operations:
        Retrieve Context Source Registration with Response Status Code set to 200     and
        Retrieve Context Source Registration with Response containing:
            * file set to 'csourceRegistrations/expectations/context-source-registration-expanded-format.json'
            * id set to '${context_source_registration_id}'
            * response set to '${response.json()}'
}
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/csourceRegistrations/{context_source_registration_id}'
        method set to 'GET'
        Retrieve Context Source Registration with data: and
    Query Parameter: context source registration id set to '${context_source_registration_id}' and
    Query Parameter: context set to '${EMPTY}'
}
